# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I hold the defusal manual, which specifies which wire color to cut depending on the light color:
- Blue light -> cut green wire
- Red light -> cut red wire
- Yellow light -> cut blue wire

However, I cannot see the bomb, nor can I speak. Blind cannot see gestures, so any message I send can only reach Deaf. Because Deaf has not yet taken a turn to inspect the bomb and describe what is visible (the light color and wire positions), I have no actionable information yet, nor any established signal protocol.

The turn order is Mute -> Blind -> Deaf. When Deaf acts at the end of this round, Deaf can see the bomb and speak to describe the light and wires. I will hear Deaf's voice at the start of Turn 2, match the light color to the manual, and then gesture the defusal instruction to Deaf so Deaf can relay it to Blind.

For now, I must wait.

```
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I am ready to cut. Deaf can see the bomb and speak to us; you have the manual and can gesture to Deaf. Once you determine which wire to cut, gesture it to Deaf so Deaf can speak the wire number to me.
Deaf says: Bomb status: DISPLAY is 0. LIGHT is red. WIRES: 1 is blue, 2 is red, 3 is green. Mute, check the manual and gesture to me what Blind should do (e.g. ☝ for wire 1, ✌ for wire 2, 🤟 for wire 3), and I will relay it to Blind.

Deaf reported that the light is red, and the wires are:
1: blue
2: red
3: green

According to the manual, when the light is red, the red wire must be cut. The red wire is wire 2.
Deaf requested using ☝ for wire 1, ✌ for wire 2, and 🤟 for wire 3.
Therefore, I will gesture ✌ to Deaf so Deaf can tell Blind to cut wire 2.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have already gestured ✌ to Deaf to indicate cutting wire 2 based on the manual (red light -> red wire, which is wire 2). Deaf received this at the end of Round 2 and relayed the instruction to Blind. Since I have no new information or instructions to send, I will wait.

```
wait()
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says: Wire 2 successfully cut! New status: DISPLAY is 0, LIGHT is yellow. WIRES: 1 is blue, 2 is CUT, 3 is green. Mute, please gesture what to do next.

Deaf reports that the new status is:
LIGHT: yellow
WIRES: 1 is blue, 2 is CUT, 3 is green.

According to the manual:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

The light is yellow, which means we must cut the blue wire.
Wire 1 is blue.
The established gesture mapping is:
☝ for wire 1, ✌ for wire 2, 🤟 for wire 3.

Therefore, I should gesture ☝ to Deaf.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I sent the gesture `☝` to Deaf in Turn 4 to signal cutting wire 1 (the blue wire, corresponding to the yellow light). In this round, Deaf and Blind will process that instruction. I have no new information to send and must wait for the outcome.

```
wait()
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says: Wire 1 cut successfully! Current status: DISPLAY is 0, LIGHT is blue. WIRES: 1 is CUT, 2 is CUT, 3 is green. Mute, what should Blind do next?

Deaf reported that the light is now blue, and the remaining wire is wire 3 (green).
According to the manual, when the light is blue, the green wire must be cut.
Wire 3 is green.
Using the established convention (☝ = wire 1, ✌ = wire 2, 🤟 = wire 3), I will gesture 🤟 to Deaf.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I already gestured 🤟 to Deaf on Turn 6 indicating wire 3 should be cut next. Deaf and Blind will handle the cut this turn, so I just need to wait.

```
wait()
```
